_comments: Variant b: gpt-4.1-mini. Same prompt, tools and pipeline; faster time to first token than gpt-4.1 but weaker on long instruction lists and multi-step tool use. promptCacheRetention '24h' isn't supported on 4.1-mini (spec list), so it's removed. Check tool correctness with `npm run evals -- --confirm` and the console's tool timeline before keeping it.
